第484章 各人的归宿（第1页）
当蓝若晴赶到昭华宫的时候，只见上官莹雪抱着襁褓中的婴儿。
蓝若晴快步的走向上官莹雪，关切的问道：“生了？男孩儿女孩儿？”
上官莹雪展开笑容，看着蓝若晴，说道：“是个小皇子！若晴，你看他长得好可爱，你也来抱抱！”
蓝若晴摇了摇头，问道：“那汐冷呢？怎么样？”
“是的！太医说因为早产，流血过多，所以……”
“所以怎么样了？”听到上官莹雪这样说，蓝若晴的心反而冷静下来。
她好像猜测到了什么，可是她又怕听到什么。
虽然蓝汐冷一直都是与她对立的，可是在她的心中，还是期盼着蓝汐冷不会有事。
“哦！”蓝若晴只是短短的回答了一句。
蓝汐冷的突然离开，让蓝若晴心中有一种空落落的感觉。
就这么的离开了吗？不过才十四岁的年纪。
蓝若晴的心中，突然涌起一丝惋惜。
如果蓝汐冷不是如此的争强好胜，此时的她大概在哪个大户人家中享着清福，做着少奶奶。
也许还会母凭子贵的，扶成了正房也说不定。
皇甫皓轩在蓝若晴的身后，扶着她的肩膀，坐在椅子上。
他蹲在蓝若晴的面前，对她说道：“若晴，不要去想了。依蓝汐冷的性子，她无论在哪里，都是不可能幸福的。现在她离开了，对她又何尝不是一件好事？难道让她在这清冷的宫中，孤老一辈子吗？”
“我知道，道理我都懂。只是她就这样子离开，我还真是一时之间没办法接受。还有孩子怎么办？他这么小就失去了娘亲，以后的日子要怎样过呢？”

上官莹雪见蓝若晴伤心，突然开口说道：“孩子的事情我与翼王已经商量过了，若晴，你就不必担心了。”
皇甫亦轩正好从门外进来，看到皇甫皓轩与蓝若晴的背影，还有满脸笑容的上官莹雪。
“是的，若晴，我们已经商量过了，蓝汐冷在宫中的这段时间，一直都是冬雪在照顾她。而冬雪也的确是对蓝汐冷非常的好。所以我与翼王商量，让冬雪嫁给翼王做侧妃。至于这个孩子，就说是冬雪与翼王的。这样子孩子的身份也正明了，冬雪也有了个好的归宿，不是吗？”
“莹雪，我们什么时候商议的事情？”反对的是皇甫亦轩。
虽然他的府中有很多个侍宠的小妾，可是他也没到随便什么人都接收的程度。
“就是刚刚商议过的，你不是点头同意了吗？”上官莹雪趁着皇甫皓轩与蓝若晴都回头看皇甫亦轩的时候，轻轻的对她点了点头。
“哦，你是说刚才你让我答应的事。是的，我同意了。就按照你说的办！”皇甫亦轩知道上官莹雪这样做，必定是有她的打算。
而上官莹雪的做法，向来都是十分正确的。

Chapter 484 Everyone’s destination (page 1)
When Lan Ruoqing rushed to Zhaohua Palace, she saw Shangguan Yingxue holding the infant baby.
Lan Ruoqing walked quickly towards Shangguan Yingxue and asked with concern: "Have you given birth? A boy or a girl?"
Shangguan Yingxue smiled, looked at Lan Ruoqing, and said, "It's a little prince! Ruoqing, look at how cute he is, come and give him a hug too!"
Lan Ruoqing shook her head and asked, "What about Xi Leng? How is it?"
"Yes! The imperial doctor said that it was due to premature birth and excessive bleeding, so..."
"So what happened?" When Shangguan Yingxue said this, Lan Ruoqing calmed down.
She seemed to have guessed something, but she was afraid of hearing something.
Although Lan tide Leng had always been against her, in her heart, she still hoped that Lan tide Leng would be fine.
"Oh!" Lan Ruoqing just replied briefly.
Lan Xi Leng's sudden departure left Lan Ruoqing with an empty feeling in her heart.
Did you just leave like that? But he was only fourteen years old.
Lan Ruoqing suddenly felt a trace of regret in her heart.
If Lan Xileng hadn't been so competitive, she would probably be enjoying a happy life as a young mistress in a wealthy family.
Maybe the mother is more valuable than the son, and maybe she can become the first wife.
Huangfu Haoxuan was behind Lan Ruoqing, holding her shoulders and sitting on the chair.
He squatted in front of Lan Ruoqing and said to her: "Ruoqing, don't think about it. With Lan Xileng's temperament, she cannot be happy no matter where she is. Now that she has left, isn't it a good thing for her? Should she be left alone in this cold palace for the rest of her life?"
"I know, I understand the truth. It's just that I couldn't accept her leaving like this. What about the child? He lost his mother at such a young age. How will he live in the future?"
Seeing Lan Ruoqing's sadness, Shangguan Yingxue suddenly said, "I have already discussed the matter with King Yi about the child. Ruoqing, you don't have to worry."
Huangfu Yixuan happened to come in from the door and saw the backs of Huangfu Haoxuan and Lan Ruoqing, as well as Shangguan Yingxue with a smile on her face.
"Yes, Ruo Qing, we have already discussed it. During the time Lan Xi Leng was in the palace, Dong Xue was always taking care of her. And Dong Xue was indeed very good to Lan Xi Leng. So I discussed with King Yi to let Dong Xue marry King Yi as his concubine. As for this child, let's say it belongs to Dong Xue and King Yi. In this way, the identity of the child is clear, and Dong Xue has a good home, right?"
"Yingxue, when did we discuss this matter?" The person who objected was Huangfu Yixuan.
Although there were many concubines in his house, he was not ready to accept just anyone.
"That's what we just discussed, didn't you nod in agreement?" Shangguan Yingxue took advantage of Huangfu Haoxuan and Lan Ruoqing to look back at Huangfu Yixuan, and nodded to her gently.
"Oh, you're talking about what you asked me to promise just now. Yes, I agreed. Just do as you say!" Huangfu Yixuan knew that Shangguan Yingxue must have had her own intentions when doing this.
Shangguan Yingxue's approach has always been very correct.
